passive_jaw_model.assumption: Elastic opening stop and conservative lower tooth contact angle. Powered exhibit commands calibrated closed zero.

scope: Rigid coupled neck and jaw, fitted approximate torque-limited position dynamics. Live Planner with sampled camera geometry, encoder and bus model. No actual MediaPipe video, wiring loads, current/temperature measurement, gear flex, no physical cycles. Eye trajectory uses the position profile and encoder model. Direct reversal is a separate engineering stress case. Actual servo tuning, calibrated spans and thermal limits need bench measurements.
